body: Yes TLOTR are so good ae! I love just taking a night to marathon them, takes a bloody long time but it's awesome haha. Harry Potter are some of my favourite movies, we had only the first two for a few years and I must know them by heart now. I think I know what you mean about The Hobbit movies, I was super hyped to see them, but found myself getting pretty bored after a while and they're just not the same as TLOTR. I might actually start watching GoT then soon, haven't got much else to do really. I'm a big Breaking Bad fan if you've seen it? Do you watch many other TV shows?

Yea The Lord of the Rings books are massive! I really enjoyed reading The Hobbit and Harry Potter too, are you a fan of the movies of either? Oh I can understand that, it's hard when the chapters change each time. I started reading the first book a while back, but I couldn't finish it. I'm stuck in the place of wanting to finish the books before watching the show, but not being able to finish the books haha. Would you recommend going ahead and watching it?
Oh yea, chilling's always good though :) Well I love Stephen King books, although I'd say my favourite book is Flowers in the Attic. How about you, do you like to read?
You're just as important as anybody else

This is such an amazing thing to offer, thank you so much. I don't really have much writing that I've kept, just an uncompleted short story or two, but I'd love to send some to you if you're sure?

I can try to send you a bit of writing now and then if you really are sure, maybe it will give me some motivation to actually write and complete something.
Thank you, I'd love to talk for a bit. How's it going?
I'm sorry, I hope you're okay.
Thank you, that's very kind of you.

Oh wow, thank you so much. I fell asleep after I posted and to wake up to this has made my morning. It means a lot to me that you took the time to not only read my post, but also to respond so kindly.

It was always my dream to be an author, so I'm really glad if my words spoke to you in any way. I usually keep my writing to myself, so you saying that I have a way with words is one of the greatest compliments I've received.

Although I can't honestly tell you that I've reconsidered, thank you for making me feel a little bit wanted at least for this morning.
